# Vendored `mcap` 0.26.0

- **Source:** crates.io `mcap` 0.26.0 (<https://github.com/foxglove/mcap>), `src/` and `README.md` as published.
- **License:** MIT (crate manifest `license = "MIT"`). The crates.io package carries no LICENSE file, so the upstream MIT text (foxglove/mcap `LICENSE`, Copyright (c) Foxglove Technologies Inc) is copied to [`LICENSE`](LICENSE).
- **Manifest:** the published `Cargo.toml` without its example/test/bench targets and dev-dependencies (those files are not vendored). Everything else is unchanged.
- **Patch (dot-logger ADR-010 amendment, 2026-11-11, EV-068):** `src/write.rs` `ChunkWriter` — for an uncompressed chunk the compressed-bytes CRC layer is not created, and `finish` reuses the uncompressed CRC as the compressed CRC for the data section. Upstream hashed the same bytes twice. Output bytes, including every CRC value, are identical.
- **Reader hardening (REV-055 RV-136, 2026-11-16):** `src/sans_io/linear_reader.rs` rejects short chunk headers, unequal uncompressed sizes and records crossing an uncompressed chunk boundary. `prevalidate_chunk_crcs` now buffers and parses every complete chunk before yielding records, including CRC-zero chunks; both compressed and decompressed sizes obey the caller limit. A zero CRC means no checksum, rather than permission to yield a partial chunk. Valid file bytes and the default streaming behavior for valid inputs are unchanged.
- **Writer compatibility (TASK-031 S3, 2026-11-18):** `src/write.rs` adds opt-in top-level Schema/Channel registration through `WriteOptions::chunk_registrations(false)`. Message chunking and indexing continue as before. Dot-logger uses this option to avoid a registration-only chunk when a loss baseline or prefix flush comes before the first message.
- **Patch file:** [`local-changes.patch`](local-changes.patch) is the whole diff of `src/` against the crates.io 0.26.0 package (all three changes above). Applying it to that package with `patch -p1` reproduces this `src/` exactly; regenerate it with `diff -ruN` against a fresh copy after any change here.
- **Check:** upstream tests on the patched full package gave the same results as the original (lib 130 Pass; 7 integration tests fail identically in both for fixture files absent from the package).
- **Reader check:** the patched source overlaid on the cached full crates.io package passes **131 lib tests** (`cargo +1.96.0 test --offline --lib --all-features`); product regressions are in `tc_014_standard` f13~f18 and CLI integration tests, tracked in EV-082.
- **Security:** `cargo audit` does not check path packages, so MCAP advisories must be checked by hand (GitHub/RustSec for `mcap`) when dependencies are reviewed. Drop this patch once upstream hashes uncompressed chunks once.
- **Untrusted input boundary (REV-071 RV-180, 2026-11-21):** the general reader API of this crate (`Summary`, `MessageStream`, attachment, metadata and index readers, and `parse_record` for most opcodes) can panic or over-allocate on corrupt input: unchecked slicing and offset additions, and `McapString` allocating its declared `u32` length before checking the remaining bytes. dot-logger does not use those readers on files it did not just write. Its native readers walk records with their own bounded parser (`storage::read::Fields`), and they call `mcap::parse_record` only for Schema and Channel records whose every length was checked first. Keep it that way: a new use of this crate's readers on untrusted bytes needs the same pre-validation, or a patch here.
